what_happened: Confirmed via code tracing + git history that the redeploy-checkpoint/command-gate-out.sh baseline comparison is already identity-based (comm -13 set diff since 2026-10-03, not count-based); the real escape is that any source-store-resident defect (committed in an earlier cycle) is always classified 'temporally pre-existing' within the checkpoint's own narrow pre/post window, so the existing attribution filter (which only applies to the 'candidate new' branch) never sees it.
